inspectionTickets.problem: Insufficient modeled sanitary pipe slope. Measured at 1/8" per foot.
inspectionTickets.requiredStandard: Florida Plumbing Code Section 704.1 requires minimum 1/4" per foot slope for 3" diameter pipe.
inspectionTickets.actualCondition: Pipe modeled horizontally with only 0.125 in/ft fall.
inspectionTickets.proposedRepair: Adjust pipe hanger elevation drop by 0.5 inches over 20ft run to achieve 0.25 in/ft slope.
inspectionTickets.repairNotes: Repair Swarm adjusted parameters: Adjust pipe hanger elevation drop by 0.5 inches over 20ft run to achieve 0.25 in/ft slope. (2026-08-20T17:52:20.701Z)

inspectionTickets.problem: Slab top elevation is 10.5 ft NAVD88; Flood Zone AE Base Flood Elevation is 11.0 ft NAVD88.
inspectionTickets.requiredStandard: ASCE 24-14 / Florida Building Code requires Finished Floor Elevation minimum +1 ft above BFE (12.0 ft).
inspectionTickets.actualCondition: Building finished floor modeled 1.5 ft below mandatory flood elevation line.
inspectionTickets.proposedRepair: Add 18" engineered compacted fill soil pad under slab to raise finished floor elevation to +12.5 ft NAVD88.
inspectionTickets.repairNotes: Repair Swarm adjusted parameters: Add 18" engineered compacted fill soil pad under slab to raise finished floor elevation to +12.5 ft NAVD88. (2026-08-20T17:52:37.422Z)

inspectionTickets.location: Roof Truss to Wall Plate Tie-Down Fasteners
inspectionTickets.problem: Truss hurricane clip fastener spec lists electro-galvanized nails.
inspectionTickets.requiredStandard: FBC HVHZ Section 2319 requires Hot-Dip Galvanized or Stainless Steel 316 clips within 2 miles of saltwater coast.
inspectionTickets.actualCondition: Electro-galvanized fasteners specified, prone to premature salt air rust.
inspectionTickets.proposedRepair: Update fastener schedule to Simpson Strong-Tie HDG / SS316 Hurricane Straps with SS ring-shank nails.

changeOrderRisks.issue: Sanitary pipe slope deficiency (PIPE-2-045) will cause sewer backup if uncorrected.
changeOrderRisks.recommendedMitigation: Execute Repair Swarm action to drop hanger brackets 0.5" before drywall enclosing.

changeOrderRisks.issue: Slab finished floor elevation below mandatory Base Flood Elevation line.
changeOrderRisks.recommendedMitigation: Add 18" compacted structural fill pad under slab to reach +12.5 ft NAVD88 elevation.

changeOrderRisks.recommendedMitigation: Swap electro-galvanized fasteners to 316 Stainless Steel prior to inspection sign-off.
